# Evaluation Rubric: Sprint Goal Writer

Use this rubric to evaluate the quality of the sprint goal.

| Criteria | 1 - Poor | 3 - Good | 5 - Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Focus** | Feature list | Single outcome-based goal | Unifies work; clear trade-off lever |
| **Outcome** | Activity-based | Measurable objective included | Observable result independent of features |
| **Persona** | Missing | Persona or system named | Specifically names who benefits |
| **Rationale** | Missing | Explains why the goal was chosen | Clear link between stories and the outcome |
| **Health Check** | Not performed | Completed checklist | All boxes ticked or gaps clearly explained |
